## Summary

Implemented Axi Docs bilingual source/routing support for the Axi Skills library so `/en/skills` and `/zh/skills` resolve to separate skill-library sources without changing the public surface for non-skill docs.

### Changed files
- `app/src/types/index.ts` — added `SkillSourceLocale` (`'en' | 'zh'`) and `DocSource.skillRoot?` + `DocSource.locale?`; `DocumentSourceConfig` carries them through.
- `app/src/config/documentSources.ts` — registered `axi-skills` (skillRoot `skills`, locale `en`) and `axi-skills-zh` (skillRoot `skills.zh`, locale `zh`) both pointing at the same `shared/axi-skills` path. The zh source can be disabled with `AXI_SKILLS_ZH_ENABLED=false`.
- `app/src/lib/knowledgeBase.ts` — `parseExtraSources` forwards `skillRoot`/`locale`; `collectSkillDocuments` now reads from `source.skillRoot || 'skills'`, so no path is hard-coded.
- `app/src/App.tsx` — `sourceIdForDocSet(docSet, locale, sources)` is now locale-aware; `docSetForSourceId` recognises both skill source ids. `HubPage` passes `guideLocale` and the loaded `sources` list so `/zh/skills` resolves to `axi-skills-zh` and `/en/skills` to `axi-skills`. No silent fallback to English — missing zh files leave the catalog empty.
- `app/src/components/HomeCommandCenter.tsx` — looks up the skills source by `guideLocale` first, then by `source.locale`, then by id.
- `app/vite.config.plugin.ts` — `sanitizeSource` keeps `skillRoot`/`locale` on the static manifest so the `generated/knowledge/manifest.json` and per-source bundle both expose them.

### Tests
- `app/src/lib/knowledgeBase.test.ts` — added three tests:
  1. `axi-skills` and `axi-skills-zh` exist with the expected `skillRoot`/`locale` and the same `path`.
  2. A localised `skills.zh/` mirror is read by `axi-skills-zh` while `axi-skills` keeps reading `skills/`, with no cross-fallback in either direction.
  3. `parseExtraSources` honours a custom `skillRoot` for an `AXI_DOCS_EXTRA_SOURCES_JSON` entry.
- `app/src/App.test.tsx` — added `skillsSourceZh` and `skillsCatalogZh` fixtures; rewrote the existing `/zh/skills` cases to expect the new behaviour; added two new tests covering (a) `/en/skills` ↔ `axi-skills` and `/zh/skills` ↔ `axi-skills-zh` routing, and (b) the no-silent-fallback guarantee for an empty zh catalog.

$ python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("dist/generated/knowledge/manifest.json")); \
  print([s["id"] for s in d["sources"]]); \
  print([s.get("skillRoot") for s in d["sources"] if s["id"] in ("axi-skills","axi-skills-zh")]); \
  print([s.get("locale") for s in d["sources"] if s["id"] in ("axi-skills","axi-skills-zh")])'
